Name: Marnie is a Good Aunt
Author: deleted78899363
Description:
It always sort of bugged me how Marnie treats Shane's alcoholism and depression in the canon game. Specifically in his four and seven heart events, she seems to be incredibly apathetic and even mocking of his struggles. So, this mod aims to fix up those events to make her a bit more understanding and supportive.

I'm super new to any sort of modding, so please let me know about any bugs!

Downloads.Description: Added update keys! Don't think they'll be needed, but I'll be safe.

Manifest.Name: Marnie is a Good Aunt
Manifest.Description: Makes some simple edits to Shane's four and seven heart events. Marnie is now actually supportive and caring towards Shane.
